data.name: ONE PIECE HEROINES EDITION vol.2
data.description: The second Extra Booster featuring Heroines!

cards.name: Nico Robin
cards.effect:
[Once Per Turn] When one of your Characters with the <Wisdom> attribute and without <Blocker> is K.O.'d, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Set up to 1 of your Characters with the <Wisdom> attribute and 6000 power or less as active.

cards.name: Nico Robin
cards.effect: [Your Turn] [On Play] Play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 5 or less and the <Wisdom> attribute from your hand.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.

cards.name: Nico Olvia
cards.effect: [On Play] You may trash 1 card with a [Trigger] from your hand: If your Leader is [Nico Robin], draw 2 cards.

sp_cards.name: Nami
sp_cards.effect: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew} type card other than [Nami] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

unknown_id_cards.name: Nico Robin
unknown_id_cards.effect:
[On Play] If your Leader has the {Straw Hat Crew} type, and the number of DON!! cards on your field is at least 6 less than the number on your opponent's field, draw 3 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand. Then, add up to 4 DON!! cards from your DON!! deck and rest them.

NOTE: This translation may be inaccurate due to low image quality.

data.name: THE DOMINANCE OF GOD
data.description: A Booster Pack with many cards from Big Three Themes!

cards.name: Mini-Merry
cards.effect:
[On Play] Draw 1 card, then add up to 1 DON!! card as rested from your DON!! deck.
[Activate: Main] You may rest this Stage: Give up to a total of 4 of your Leader or Characters 1 rested DON!! Card each.

cards.name: Saint Gunko
cards.effect:
[Once Per Turn] When a Character is played from your trash, draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have a Character with  8000 base power or more, add up to 1 DON!! card as active from your DON!! deck.
